capabilities: Shows all daily notes as one scrolling timeline
Loads older notes as you scroll
Searches text across every daily note
Jumps to a date or highlights the day in Calendar
Displays properties, linked mentions and foldable sections
disambiguation: Not a daily-note creator or editor; it only displays existing daily notes in a read-only stream.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or later. Read-only by design; collects no telemetry and needs no account. On phones and tablets, YouTube embeds show as preview images loaded from i.ytimg.com.
intentEvidence: You'll need daily notes set up already: Obsidian's core Daily notes plugin, or Periodic Notes
problem: Daily notes live in separate files, so reading back through them as a continuous journal means opening one note at a time.

relations.evidence: With the Calendar plugin open, the day you're reading is highlighted as you scroll
If you use Periodic Notes with its daily notes turned on, the stream uses Periodic Notes' folder and format instead.
Templates made with the core Templates plugin or with Templater are recognized when empty notes are hidden.
Dataview tables and Bases are shown the way Obsidian shows them
To edit notes in a feed, try a plugin such as Daily Notes Editor.
Thank you to the authors and maintainers of the projects that inspired this plugin

summary: Read-only view that shows all your daily notes as one continuous, scrollable journal timeline, newest first.
